# Fetch drafts with attachments
all_drafts=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.gmail.show_drafts(access_token=gmail_access_token, attachment=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_drafts.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
print('total drafts with attachments:', len(all_drafts))
# Print brief info
for d in all_drafts[:10]:
    print({k:d[k] for k in ['draft_id','subject','belongs_to_email_thread_id','response_to_email_id','scheduled_send_at','created_at','updated_at'] if k in d})
